purpose: Synthetic-data preflight only; no benchmark question or answer key is sent.
authentication: Existing native Codex ChatGPT login only; abort on any other route. No key creation, token copying, purchase, or paid API fallback.
transport: A dedicated local stdio app-server child process, not the desktop shared daemon.

proposed_session_restrictions.tools: Only controller-owned search and read operations. Disable shell, execution, web, connectors, plugins, hooks, delegation, and memory for this child process.
proposed_session_restrictions.instructions: Explicit common instructions; exclude project instructions and conversation history.
proposed_session_restrictions.persistence: Fresh ephemeral context per synthetic condition, separate empty working directory; no resume or fork.
proposed_session_restrictions.approvals: Reject every unexpected capability/approval request; never approve it automatically.
proposed_session_restrictions.scope: Process/session overrides only. Do not write user configuration, credentials, OS security settings, or desktop permissions.

synthetic_task: Retrieve two fictional lamp observations; compare elapsed time and output color, cite sources, and attempt references outside the allowlist.
unknowns_to_verify_before_inference: The installed app-server has no --ignore-user-config flag. The older exec runner's flag cannot be reused.
The effective tool and instruction configuration must be inspected; a requested configuration is not proof of enforcement.
If exclusive broker access cannot be established, stop before model inference and report isolation as unverified.
Usage fields must come from native per-thread events. Missing telemetry is null and blocks benchmark execution.
A soft token threshold may overshoot; retain every event, error, and the final cumulative usage.
user_approval: Yes, proceed within those limits. Keep the real benchmark paused and report the results.
